research.notes: The official 2022 revision document (ncic.re.kr / moe.go.kr) could not be read: the ncic page is robots-disallowed, the vivasam elementary PDF came back as binary to WebFetch, direct download was blocked by the proxy (403), and the goe.go.kr and koreascience PDFs did not contain the math standards. Only two news pages (localnaeil.com) were actually read, and they confirmed course structure and a few changes (matrices and counting in 공통수학1, equations of figures in 공통수학2, space vectors in 기하, population proportion estimation in 확률과 통계, quadratic max/min in middle school grade 3, new electives). The concept list was therefore compiled from my own memory of the 2022 curriculum and is unverified against the source. Standard codes are given only as domain-level prefixes with 'xx' placeholders; the few specific numbers (e.g. [2수01-01]) are best guesses, and the career/convergence elective prefixes ([12경수], [12인수], [12직수], [12수문], [12실통], [12수탐], [10기수]) are guesses. Elective-course topic splits (경제 수학, 인공지능 수학, 직무 수학, 수학과 문화, 실용 통계, 수학과제 탐구) are especially low-confidence. Re-verification against the official PDF is needed before use. No source text was copied.

FETCHING: I did no new WebSearch or WebFetch. To keep usage efficient, the merge relies only on the four input lists, which had already been gathered from the documents they name. Caveats carried over from those lists: the Korea list was compiled from memory (the official PDF was not read, and its standard codes are guesses with 'xx' placeholders). Korean and Common Core refs should be re-verified against the official documents before pages cite them.

STATUS RULE USED: 'existing' means the existing page's title is this same concept, so the concept uses the existing id. 'existing-partial' means a broader or university/olympiad page touches it, but a school learner needs its own page. Several school concepts can point at one existing page: euclid-basics, area-volume, descriptive-statistics, analytic-geometry, trig, exp-log, quadratics, functions, polynomials-roots. Renamed to avoid clashes with existing ids: the school 'moments' became 'moments-of-forces', because existing 'moments' is analytic number theory. Note that existing.json itself lists the id 'distributions' twice (probability distributions and Schwartz distributions). binomial-distribution and normal-distribution point to the probability one.
